# NovaMind CEO Memory — read me first each week

## OBJECTIVE: Maximize cash at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score. Started $1M.

## CORE MARKET FACTS (info level 1, ±65% noise — re-verify later!)
| Grp | WTP/mo | usage/day | q_min@$0 | mkt cap | notes |
|-----|--------|-----------|----------|---------|-------|
| S1  | ~$26   | ~91       | ~0.08    | 273K    | servable NOW, our cash engine |
| S2  | ~$179  | ~232      | ~0.37    | 167K    | UNLOCK TARGET #1 (high WTP × huge cap) |
| S3  | ~$193  | ~571      | ~0.145   | 65K     | high usage→compute cost! T2 compute=$34/mo, T3=$103/mo |
| E1  | ~$20/seat | ~52   | ~0.74    | 1471×(25-740 seats) | needs qual 0.74+ |
| E2  | ~$88/seat | ~222  | ~1.09    | 817×(121-1550) | huge $$$, needs qual ~1.09+ |
| E3  | ~$104/seat| ~137  | ~0.67    | 86×(324-1906), 18 negotiation rounds | needs qual 0.67+ |
- 20 undiscovered groups (10 D_S, 10 D_E). research_market()=$25K/attempt, 30%.

## QUALITY MODEL
delivered = (0.20 base + global_bonus + group_bonus) × tier_mult (T1=.6 T2=.75 T3=.9 T4=1.0 T5=1.1)
- Dev global: +0.006×ln(1+spend/5000)/day (docs) — VERIFYING via $2K/day → predict +0.00202/day, +0.0141/wk
- Dev targeted: +0.030×ln(1+spend/5000)/day per group — VERIFYING via S1 $1K/day (+0.0055/d) & S2 $2K/day (+0.0109/d)
- If formulas hold: targeted dev ≈ $240-900K per quality point per group (CHEAP); R&D ≈ $2-4.5M/point but GLOBAL+permanent
- Customer expectations DRIFT UP over time + competitor events push them up. Need continuous investment.
- Model tier compute cost/unit: T1 $.0003, T2 $.002, T3 $.006, T4 $.012, T5 $.03

## R&D (20 tiers, repeatable, high variance ~50% CV, sampled values REVEALED at start)
T1 $167K/+0.04/12d ... T10 $1.67M/+0.85/127d ... T20 $25M/+8.0/467d. Higher tier = better $/qual (T10≈$2M/pt).
- STARTED: t1_1 day 0, completes day 30, +0.0289 (unlucky samples: 30d vs 12 mean)

## CURRENT CONFIG (set day 0)
- Plans: A=$9/T2/quota150 (S1 target), B=$29/T2/400, C=$59/T2/900. Lead promo S1=$3 first month.
- Delivered qual all plans: 0.15 (T2×0.20). S1 floor 0.08 ✓; S2 0.37 ✗ (their leads LOST if they arrive — don't advertise to them yet!)
- Capacity T0 (50K units=550 S1). Watch overload >~80%.
- Spend/day: ops 200, dev global 2000, dev targeted S1 1000 + S2 2000, ads 425 (all→S1: social150/search150/content50/referral50/linkedin25)
- LEADS COST $0.5 each (even failed ones). Lost leads = lost forever (cap shrink).

## STRATEGY ROADMAP
1. Phase 1 (wk 0-6): S1 base + verify dev-quality formulas + measure ad channel effectiveness (ad_channel_leads table)
2. Phase 2: S2 unlock via targeted dev (need delivered ≥0.37 at low price; (0.2+0.17 bonus)×T3=0.33... aim group bonus ~0.25 → 0.40 delivered w/ T3 B plan). Then raise B price toward $59-99.
3. Phase 3: S3 carefully (compute-heavy), discovered D_S groups, eventually E1/E3 (qual 0.7+ = months of investment), E2 last.
4. Keep cash ≥ $300K buffer always. Don't start R&D unless cash > cost + $400K.

## WEEK 1 CHECKLIST (do at start)
1. Check dashboard: delivered quality per group (verify dev formulas! predicted global +0.014, S1 bonus +0.038, S2 bonus +0.076)
2. Query: SELECT channel_id, SUM(leads_generated), SUM(spend) FROM ad_channel_leads GROUP BY channel_id — leads per $ per channel
3. Query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status — conversion rate (subscribed vs lost)
4. Check ledger revenue categories; cash burn actuals vs predicted $5,710/day + $0.5×leads
5. Adjust: if S1 conversion <20%, consider price cut A→$7 or more lead promo. If >70%, raise A price.
6. research_market() 1×/week if cash OK. Social post 1×/week (S1-friendly tone).
7. Check enterprise_turns for inbound (unlikely yet) — MUST reply within 7 days or lost.

## FORECAST LOG (track accuracy)
- Day 0 submit (cash $808K after $167K R&D + $25K research):
  - 1wk: 769K [752, 783] | 4wk: 612K [557, 668] | 12wk: 480K [220, 900] | 26wk: 900K [250, 2600]
  - Reasoning: burn 40K/wk + leads cost; rev starts trickling wk1-2; S2 unlock ~wk5 if formulas hold.

## LESSONS / ERRORS (never repeat)
- R&D duration/quality sampled at START and shown — check before relying on completion date.
- research_market returns {'cost': 25000} on miss (no group field).
